title: Hereditary spastic paraplegia with recessive trait caused by mutation in KLC4 gene.

reviewer.method: Personally read complete six-page article including methods and all14 references; inspected all figures/table pixels, every populated workbook cell and two empty sheets, and both supplement print pages; adjudicated selected IV-1 and alternates IV-5/IV-6, all3 allele descriptors and all51 phenotype items.

audit.exposure_note: Mandatory HANDOFF.md reading exposed historical HG002/FGFR2 public-control case-specific rank and aggregate results. No target-case outcome files, current assigned-cohort ranks, or evaluator outputs were consulted. Not blinded. Inherited material is attributed to its original reviewer; new reading claims are limited to this method.
